result.instructions: Tools for eTermin, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments do we have tomorrow in the Berlin calendar?"; "Show the free slots for the 60-minute consultation next Monday."; "Book Anna Schmidt for Thursday 10:00 with the main calendar and do not send an email.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes eTermin data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run etermin_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run etermin_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run etermin_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. etermin_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: etermin_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the calendars (bookable resources or staff) in the eTermin account, or one calendar when calendarid is given. Use the ids in the other tools. GET /api/calendar.

tools.name: etermin_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the bookable services, or one service when id is given. Filter by service group with service_group_id. GET /api/service.

service_group_id.description: Return only services in this group.

languageid.description: Language code for names and descriptions, for example DE or EN.

tools.name: etermin_list_service_groups
tools.title: List service groups
tools.description: List service groups, or one group when servicegroupid is given. GET /api/servicegroup.

languageid.description: Language code for names and descriptions, for example DE or EN.

tools.name: etermin_get_available_slots
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: Get the free booking slots on a day, for one calendar or several, and for one or more services. Set range_end with range_search to search a span of days. GET /api/timeslots.

range_search.description: true: search forward from date until slots are found.

range_end.description: Last day of the search, yyyy-mm-dd. Needs range_search.

duration_minutes.description: Override the slot length in minutes.

capacity.description: Capacity needed, if the account uses capacity.

tools.name: etermin_get_working_times
tools.title: Get working times
tools.description: Get the weekly working times of one calendar (calendar_id) or of all calendars (all = true). GET /api/workingtimes.

calendar_id.description: Calendar whose working times to list.

all.description: true: list the working times of all calendars.

tools.name: etermin_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List the absences (holidays, blocked days) of one calendar. GET /api/calendarsnonworkingtimes.

tools.name: etermin_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments in a date range (start and end, yyyy-mm-dd), or the appointments of one contact (email or cid), or one appointment (appid or id). GET /api/appointment.

start.description: First day of the range, yyyy-mm-dd.

end.description: Last day of the range, yyyy-mm-dd.

contact_id.description: Contact id (cid); lists this contact's appointments.

email.description: Contact email; lists this contact's appointments.

limited.description: true: shorter records, useful for long lists.

tools.name: etermin_find_contact
tools.title: Find a contact
tools.description: Find a contact by email, external id or contact id (cid). GET /api/contact.

tools.name: etermin_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact in the eTermin account. With update_if_exists = true and an email, an existing contact with that email is updated instead. POST /api/contact.

newsletter.description: true: the contact agrees to newsletters.

update_if_exists.description: true: update the contact that has this email.

tools.name: etermin_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment in a calendar. By default the booking is refused when the slot is taken (check_slot_free = true). Only send_confirmation_email = true sends an email to the customer. POST /api/appointment.

check_slot_free.description: Default true: refuse the booking if the slot is taken.

send_confirmation_email.description: Default false: true sends a confirmation email to the email address.

tools.name: etermin_delete_appointment
tools.title: Delete an appointment
tools.description: Delete an appointment by eTermin id (appid) or by your external id. A customer email needs the external id. DELETE /api/appointment.

send_cancellation_email.description: true: email the customer. Needs external_id.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with eTermin
prompts.description: What you can do with eTermin here, with example requests to try.
